name: web-search-searxng
description: The REAL web-search engine that needs NO credential (provider id `searxng`): one HTTP GET to a SearXNG instance's JSON API (`<baseUrl>/search?format=json`), the raw `results` array handed to the web-search@1 seam for normalization, and every HTTP failure mapped onto the typed web-search.* reasons (401/403 auth-failed, 429 rate-limited, unreachable network, a non-JSON body bad-response, a set of dead upstream engines provider-error). Availability is a LOCAL check (no credential configured -> usable, or a credential-store read), never a network call. The OPTIONAL bearer token is a credential NAME resolved at call time through credentials@1, so the plugin loads in a deployment that has no credential and simply reports itself unusable when the row asks for one.

config.description: Which instance to query, the OPTIONAL credential NAME and how the call is shaped. Never a credential VALUE.

baseUrl.description: SearXNG instance base url; the engine GETs <baseUrl>/search?format=json. Point it at your OWN instance to avoid sharing a public one.

credential.description: OPTIONAL credential NAME resolved through credentials@1 and sent as `Authorization: Bearer` (most instances are key-free; only set this for a protected instance - the value is never in this file, a log or an answer).

timeoutMs.description: Per-request deadline in ms (the seam's own deadline still applies).

maxResults.description: Hard ceiling of the `count` this engine is asked for.

safesearch.description: The instance's safesearch level the request's `safe` hint maps to (0 off, 1 moderate, 2 strict); unset maps safe:true -> 1 and safe:false -> 0.

categories.description: Optional SearXNG category filter, e.g. `general`, passed through verbatim.

engines.description: Optional comma-separated engine allow-list of the instance, e.g. `duckduckgo,brave`.
